name: Ladder Family
summary: Two ambitious parents and their gifted kids: promotions and grades, stress when things slip, no patience for mess.

sims.persona: Mira (Adult): Ambitious, Perfectionist, Workaholic, Neat, Snob. Upside: faster job performance and promotions, more wishes for career; higher quality output (art, cooking, homework). Downside: unhappy on days off, works overtime, misses family time; dislikes cheap things, insults, relationship hits.

expect.plus: faster job performance and promotions, more wishes for career
expect.minus: stressed and unhappy when not promoted for a while (Stressed moodlet)
slower work, unhappy with anything less than perfect
